The following events took place in '''41 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] traveled to [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] and presented himself to the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], beginning the Sith Tribe's [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|emergence]].
*[[Natasi Daala]] [[Second Battle of Fondor|returned]] at the request of [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]].
*Pellaeon was [[Death/Legends|assassinated]] by [[Tahiri Veila]].
*The [[Hutt underground]] and the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region were absorbed into the [[Confederation]].
*The [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] is revived and withdraws from [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], joining the [[Second Galactic Civil War|war]] on its side.
*The Galactic Alliance split into two factions, [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|one]] led by [[Darth Caedus]] from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Alliance-in-exile|another]] by [[Cha Niathal]] from [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]].
*Tahiri Veila became the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] of Darth Caedus.
*[[Mirta Gev]] and [[Ghes Orade]] were [[Wedding of Ghes Orade and Mirta Gev|married]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].
*[[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] [[Battle of Uroro Station|killed]] Darth Caedus.
*Tahiri Veila was taken into [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] custody by [[Ben Skywalker]].
*[[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]], [[Chume'da]] of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] was placed in the custody of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Solo]] and the [[New Jedi Order]] after her "[[Battle of Uroro Station|death]]."
*[[Lumiya's Sith]] and the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]] fell, thus leaving only the [[One Sith]], who had been in hiding on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] since [[30 ABY/Legends|30 ABY]].
*Ben Skywalker was declared a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] by his [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].
*A peace agreement was established between all involved parties in the war, reforming the structure of the Galactic Alliance. Natasi Daala ascended to the rank of [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] of the newly reunited Alliance.
*The [[Jedi Coalition]] was reformed into the New Jedi Order and reunited with the Galactic Alliance.
*The Second Galactic Civil War ended.
*The [[Sepan Civil War]] ended.<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>
*The [[Sith dreadnaught]] [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']] [[Time travel/Legends|appeared]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] following a faulty [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump [[5000 BBY/Legends|5,041 years earlier]] while attempting to escape a Jedi [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|assault]].<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref>
*The [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|Lost Tribe War]] begins.
*[[Jaden Korr]] followed a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]] to the Unknown Regions and found the ''Harbinger'' and an abandoned [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]–era [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facility, complete with [[Community|mad clones]].
